personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Fusion: B2B High-Density Utility + Earthy Natural Palette)
personality_one_liner: A crisp, trustworthy B2B order-punching tool with the calm, earthy warmth of natural incense.

spacing.rule: Generous outer padding (lg) to frame the app comfortably, with tight, high-utility inner spacing (sm/md) for order punching lists.

do's: Use glass for the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use glass for sticky cart summary at the bottom of the catalog screen
Use glass for sticky headers over scrollable order history lists
dont's: Never blur product catalog rows or actionable task cards
Do not use glass for form inputs or standard dashboard cards

screens.name: Login_Register
screens.purpose: Onboard users quickly using GST numbers, assigning distinct roles securely.

states.error: Toast or inline text under GST input explaining invalid format.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top (incense / nature) with a bottom-heavy surfaceSecondary card containing the GST input, Role Picker (segmented control), and a sticky full-width primary CTA.

screens.name: Dashboard_Home
screens.purpose: Role-specific command center showing order metrics and actionable tasks.

states.loading: Skeleton cards for metrics and task list.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty warehouse shelf + 'No pending tasks'.

screens.layout: Top sticky header with role indicator badge (e.g., 'Retailer'). Row of two stat cards (Pending, Completed). Below that, a list of 'Actionable Tasks' (orders from subordinates needing attention). Floating Action Button (FAB) or sticky CTA to 'Punch New Order'.

screens.name: Catalog_OrderPunching
screens.purpose: Dense, high-speed ordering interface with live stock visibility.

states.error: Error banner + 'Failed to load catalog. Retry'.

screens.layout: Search/Filter bar pinned at top. List view (not grid) of products. Each row displays Product Name, SKU, Live Stock badge (color-coded), Price, and an inline +/- stepper control. Bottom of screen holds a glass-styled fixed Cart Summary bar showing Total Value and 'Review Order' button.

screens.name: Order_History
screens.purpose: Track the status of all placed and received orders.
screens.layout: Filter tabs (All, Pending, Dispatched). Scrollable list of order cards. Tapping a card opens a Bottom Sheet showing the order details and a vertical timeline (Placed -> Confirmed -> Dispatched -> Delivered).

catalog_hero.alt: A close-up view of incense sticks aligned in a manufacturing setting

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure UI remains strictly LIGHT MODE as per constraints, using the provided earthy palette (Sage Green primary, Sand/Off-white surfaces) to inject brand warmth without losing enterprise crispness.

Implement distinct Dashboard views checking the user's role (Retailer vs. Distributor vs. Admin) to conditionally render Actionable Tasks. Distributors only see orders from Retailers. Admins see orders from Distributors.
In the Catalog screen, favor list-density. Use inline +/- steppers on the product rows instead of a multi-step add-to-cart modal, enabling rapid multi-product order punching.
Live stock data must be displayed directly on the product row in the catalog, mapped from Supabase, so users don't try to punch out-of-stock items.
For the Order History timeline, implement a vertical stepper UI inside a bottom sheet or detail screen (Placed -> Confirmed -> Dispatched -> Delivered).
Keep the primary 'Punch Order' CTA sticky at the bottom of the catalog screen (using glassmorphism) so the user never has to scroll to submit their order.
Do not use generic blue/indigo anywhere; adhere strictly to the provided natural palette (Brand: #4F6354).
Architect the checkout flow modularly so a payment gateway step can be inserted before order confirmation in the future.
